acceptance_criteria.text: Every change preserves existing functional and visual assertions; no baseline, mask, threshold, or skip is changed to hide a regression.

All eight benchmark families expose explicit canonical readiness, provider entitlement, point-in-time holdings/classification/weights/history, continuity, provenance, and unsupported-role states without silent fallback or fabricated data.

The live-data top-down workflow links benchmark, style, sector, industry/proxy, and constituent views with synchronized symbols/timeframes, indicators, drawings, keyboard behavior, save/restore, source lock/edit states, and actionable freshness.

Current and historical breadth contracts support generic condition predicates, denominator/exclusion/member-level/source lineage evidence, derived-series semantics, and supported ratio/history queries.

Market Map, breadth, rotation, ranking, leadership, concentration, dispersion, drawdown, volatility, correlation, and seasonality consumers use source-polymorphic, period-aware, bounded, provenance-visible contracts where data supports them.

Python/Study Lab outputs remain immutable and lineage-preserving while compatible shapes promote to columns, filters, scans, gauges, alerts, chart plots, and strategy signals with explicit capability errors.

The mapped V25 reference states are implemented and validated across source selection, treemap geometry, breadth/study/promotion, loading/error/freshness, keyboard, tool menus, popouts, and state restoration using the unchanged visual acceptance policy.

Golden Layout and native/browser window resilience, endurance beyond 100 rounds, 100k-point/10k-row performance, accessibility, security, sandbox, migration, and logging checks provide actionable evidence.

Focused backend/frontend/unit/integration checks, authenticated browser flows, all four visual projects, provider/data probes, and the final exact-tip exhaustive integration gate pass or record an explicit reproducible blocker.
The branch stops at ready_for_human_review with clean, synchronized branch-owned workstream records and no integration, promotion, deployment, or mutation of another worktree.
